name: missive
description: Search and read your Missive conversations, look up contacts, mailboxes, teams, shared labels, and saved responses, and create or update message drafts. Send drafts when requested, organize conversations with labels, and view or manage events on connected calendars. Access depends on your Missive account permissions, organization settings, and granted OAuth scopes.

interface.longDescription: Search and read conversations across your connected Missive accounts, find contacts and team inboxes, draft and send messages, and organize conversations with labels. You can also view and manage connected calendar events. Access follows your Missive account permissions, organization settings, and granted OAuth scopes.
defaultPrompt: Draft a reply to my latest customer email.
Show my calendar events for tomorrow.
